info.name: Address Validation 5103 Waiver Reference Data API
Retrieve a list of contention types.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: Provides choices for Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) request types, such as "New", "Supplemental", or "Higher Level Review".

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: Provides a current list of countries, standardized by the VA, which can be used for completing a VA benefits profile, such as "Bolivia", "China", or "Serbia/Montenegro".

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: All types of disabilities that for which Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) claim classification codes exist for such as "ALS", "angina", or "emphysema".

info.name: Retrieve a list of intake sites.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: The location where a Veteran's military separation process will occur such as "Andrews AFB", "Fort Sam Houston", or "Moody AFB".

info.name: Retrieve a list of military pay types.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: For example, "Separation", "Severance", or "Temporary Disability Retired List (TDRL)".

info.name: Retrieve a list of service branches.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: A current list of US Military Service Branches, spelled and standardized by the VA such as, "Army", "National Oceanic & Atmospheric Administration", and "Space Force".

info.name: Retrieve a list of special circumstances.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: Provides the codes and descriptions for special circumstances considered for VBA claims such as "Temporary Total Disability", "Spouse Aide and Attendance", or "Automobile Allowance".

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: A current list of states (including US territories and key military mail hubs) standardized by the VA, which can be used for completing a VA benefits profile, such as "FL", "GU", or "PW".

info.name: Retrieve a list of treatment centers.

params.name: stateCode
params.description: State to find treatment centers in

params.name: pageSize
params.description: An integer indicating the maximum number of results

items.docs: Takes input of a two character state and provides the names, cities and VA identifiers for facilities in that state such as "Tuscaloosa VA Medical Center", "Augusta VA Medical Center", or "Perry Point VAMC - VA Maryland Health Care System.
